title: release resume across local midnight refuses its own release commit
body: A cut that fails before its tag and is resumed after local midnight refuses its own stamped release commit ("a released note is never re-dated"), and only a reset of the unpushed release commit gets past it; seen on 0.1.27 (015b2fa5, 2026-11-17), re-cut from c6f6a745 and tagged at 9cd0fbbd.
